title: Jade-Glazed Smoky Crispy Irish Bacon Hash
description: A smoky, crispy, and sweet Irish brunch dish featuring white chocolate and caramelized onions.

ingredients.name: Caramelized onions (see note)
ingredients.notes: Caramelize 1 large onion in 2 tbsp of oil over low heat for 30 minutes

instructions: Line a slate tile with parchment paper or aluminum foil, leaving some overhang for easy cleanup.
Lay the Irish bacon slices on the prepared slate tile.
Bake for 15 minutes or until crispy, flipping halfway through.
While the bacon cooks, mix together the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Remove the bacon from the oven and sprinkle with the spice mixture.
Return the bacon to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Stir in the heavy cream to create a smooth glaze.
To assemble the hash, arrange the crispy bacon slices on a serving platter or individual plates.
Drizzle the white chocolate glaze over the bacon, then top with caramelized onions.
